pricefighter.no_rules_desc: Create a rule to control strategy for a sku, category, or channel.
pricefighter.confirm_delete_rule: This pricing rule will be permanently deleted.
pricefighter.no_history_desc: Applied price changes will show up here.
pricefighter.scope_value_required: Enter a value for the selected scope.
pricefighter.recommendation_hold_desc: Keep the current price — competitor is within the neutral band around baseline.
pricefighter.recommendation_compete_desc: Go below the competitor reference (R − undercut), clamped to the price floor.
pricefighter.recommendation_raise_desc: Raise toward the competitor reference (R − headroom) when we're priced too low.
pricefighter.strategy_tooltip: What the engine does per (SKU × market): Hold keeps price, Compete undercuts the competitor, Raise lifts an underpriced item. Bounds (floor/MAP) and max step always apply.
pricefighter.scope_type_tooltip: Which products this rule targets. Precedence when several match: SKU > Category > Channel (most specific wins).
pricefighter.market_tooltip: The channel this channel-scoped rule applies to. Narrower SKU/Category rules override it.

access.title: Access
access.override_replaces: A saved set REPLACES the level below it — it is not added to it.
access.unresolved_group: this group is no longer in the directory
access.directory_unavailable: The directory could not be reached, so the list is not shown. This is not the same as there being no groups.
access.no_grant: You hold no grant. Ask a SYSADMIN to give you one.
access.service_accounts_cli: A service account is created on the host with manage.py escaccess_service_account, because it also creates a Django user.
access.unclassified_staff_why: These are staff accounts that are neither linked to SSO nor marked as machines, so nothing tells a consumer what they are.
